name: Spitalfields Market
summary: A covered market whose 1887 market hall sits alongside a modern shopping precinct. It describes itself as a destination for fashion, food and fun.

music.notes: Outdoor summer dance sessions: swing on selected July and August dates, and tango lessons (free) followed by dancing.

accessibility.notes: Visitors are asked to check with individual shops and restaurants about their own access. Public toilets are on Lamb Street.

evidence.quote: This East End stalwart combines the refurbished 1887 covered market with a modern shopping precinct.
Spitalfields Market is a 1-stop destination for fashion, food and fun, and the gateway to East London.
Taking place across selected dates in July and August, Swing Patrol at Spitalfields is a chance to enjoy two hours of music, movement and feel-good dancing
Taking place across selected dates this summer, Tango @ Spitalfields offers free beginner-friendly tango lessons followed by outdoor dancing
The Spitalfields Market is wheelchair accessible throughout.
A designated accessible toilet designed for wheelchair users and others with visible and non-visible accessibility requirements is available within the main public areas.
Please check with individual shops and restaurants for accessibility.
You can find public toilets in Lamb Street
Spitalfields Market is open every day of the week, Mon-Fri 08:00-23:00
